name: Alara
description: Alara is a plane that was broken into five shards, Bant, Esper, Grixis, Jund and Naya, and later reunited into a single plane flowing with all five colors of mana.

description_citations.text: "Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Alara is a plane that was broken into five shards, Bant, Esper, Grixis, Jund and Naya, and later reunited into a single plane flowing with all five colors of mana.

citations.text: "Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Alara". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: An unknown planeswalker plundered Alara for its mana millennia ago, tearing the plane into five shards that recovered their mana only in part.

citations.text: "Alara", section "The Sundering". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Shards of Alara", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Shards of Alara", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Nicol Bolas planned the convergence all along, coming to Alara to feed on its mana, and he fomented chaos and destroyed the obelisks to speed the merging of the shards.

citations.text: "Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Alara", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: In the Conflux the shards merged into the Maelstrom, awakening Progenitus, and Alara became whole again.

citations.text: "Conflux (event)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Shard Convergence (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
"Progenitus", section "The Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: The reunited plane became a patchwork where cultures clashed and wars broke out between the former shards, with Esper, Grixis, Naya and Bant forces attacking across the old borders.

citations.text: "Alara", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

"Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Ajani conjured a spiritual echo of Bolas that attacked him and forced him to retreat from Alara.

citations.text: "Conflux (event)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Later, travel between the former shards normalized and a new equilibrium formed.

citations.text: "Alara", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Elesh Norn's Machine Legion targeted Alara, and the Maelstrom awakened to fight on its behalf.

citations.text: "Alara", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Bant", section "New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Jund", section "New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: As of the latest material Alara is a single reunited plane, struck by the Phyrexian invasion and defended by the awakened Maelstrom, and a 2026 story mentions it as the plane of the Conflux Wars in which Jazal died.

citations.text: "Alara", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Bant", section "New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Hybrid appears in Alara Reborn as an easier way to play three-colored cards.
timeline.quote: as an easier way to play three-colored cards

citation.text: "Hybrid mana", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Alara split into shards, Bant's martial traditions became ceremonial and ritualized.
timeline.quote: Over the years, Bant's armies became less martial and more ceremonial.

citation.text: "Time for Esper". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Grixis separated from Alara and lost access to white and green mana.
timeline.quote: But when the subplane became separated from the others, it lost access to its white and green mana.

citation.text: "Alive and Unwell". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Alara is conceived as five separate worlds (shards), each defined by what mana it lacks as much as by the mana that flows in it.
timeline.quote: We were able to split the setting up into five entire worlds (not ten, ouch!)

citation.text: "Faction + Fiction". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The obelisks of the shards have long faithfully served forgotten purposes since the plane shattered.
timeline.quote: Centuries have passed since the plane shattered

citation.text: Obelisk of Naya (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: An unknown planeswalker plunders Alara for its mana, shattering the plane into shards in the Sundering.
timeline.quote: an unknown Planeswalker plundered Alara for its mana

citation.text: "Alara", section "The Sundering". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Asha sacrifices herself in battle with the demon Malfegor.
timeline.quote: Asha, the plane's protector, sacrificed herself in battle with the demon Malfegor .

citation.text: "Alara", section "The Sundering". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Following the Sundering of Alara, hydras are limited to the Shards of Naya and Jund; during the Conflux new hydras such as the Apocalypse Hydra come into conflict with other Shards.
timeline.quote: During the Conflux , new types of Hydras, like the Apocalypse Hydra , appeared that came into conflict with the other Shards, like Bant .

citation.text: "Hydra", section "Alara". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ajani summons the essence of Bolas's soul to fight Bolas, and the two dragons vanish.
timeline.quote: he summoned the essence of Bolas's soul to fight for him

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Alara Unbroken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Worldheart Phoenix manifests on Alara during the events of the Conflux.
timeline.quote: One known exemplar was the Worldheart Phoenix who manifested during the events of the Conflux .

citation.text: "Phoenix", section "Alara". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: An unknown planeswalker tears the single plane of Alara asunder millennia ago, harvesting its mana.
timeline.quote: for an unknown planeswalker tore the plane asunder millennia ago, harvesting of its mana

citation.text: "Shards of Alara", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The disaster breaks Alara along color lines into five shards, which recover their mana only in part.
timeline.quote: This disaster broke Alara along color lines into incomplete planes called shards

citation.text: "Shards of Alara", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Flight of the White Cat webcomic tells of Ajani's origins on Alara.
timeline.quote: Flight of the White Cat is a webcomic about Ajani 's origins on Alara .

citation.text: "Shards of Alara", section "Webcomics". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Shards of Alara realigned, some vedalken migrated from Esper to Naya.
timeline.quote: some migrated to Naya after the Shards of Alara realigned

citation.text: "Vedalken", section "Alara". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The column notes that Grixis was once connected to the other shards and flush with life, before becoming a world of death.
timeline.quote: Grixis is a world of death—but at one time, when Alara was young, it was still connected to the other shards, and still flush with life.

citation.text: "Shards of Alara in Italics". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: As Grixis collides with the rest of Alara, the worlds begin to hear the whispers of the forgotten dead.
timeline.quote: As Grixis collided with the rest of Alara, the worlds began to hear the hateful whispers of the forgotten dead.

citation.text: Voices from the Void (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The shards complete their merging and Alara is whole again.
timeline.quote: Alara is broken no more.

citation.text: Shard Convergence (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The conflux nears and Bolas's long machinations are about to triumph.
timeline.quote: After years of world-bending machinations, Bolas's triumph is at hand.

citation.text: Conflux (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: As the shards merge into the Maelstrom, their mana fuses into new monstrosities.
timeline.quote: As the shards merged into the Maelstrom, their mana energies fused into new monstrosities.

citation.text: Fusion Elemental (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Progenitus, the Soul of the World, returns.
timeline.quote: The Soul of the World has returned.

citation.text: Progenitus (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Ancient Ziggurat reappears when Progenitus awakens.
timeline.quote: When Progenitus awakened, the temple emerged again.

citation.text: Ancient Ziggurat (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas foments chaos and destroys the obelisks, accelerating the merging of the shards into the Conflux.
timeline.quote: he accelerated the process until the shards merged in an event known as the Conflux

citation.text: "Alara", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The shards reunite as a patchwork plane and cultures clash and wars ensue.
timeline.quote: As the boundaries between the shards dissolved, cultures clashed, and wars ensued.

citation.text: "Alara", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Travel between the former shards normalizes and a new equilibrium forms.
timeline.quote: travel between the former shards became normalized, and a new equilibrium was born across the plane

citation.text: "Alara", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bant's borders merge with the other shards until it becomes part of New Alara; its castles lie in ruin.
timeline.quote: Its borders merged more and more with the other shards until it became part of New Alara.

citation.text: "Bant", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A sinister force conspires to reunite the Shards of Alara, beginning the Conflux.
timeline.quote: A powerful and infinitely sinister force is conspiring to reunite the Shards of Alara.

citation.text: "Conflux", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Esper's borders merge with Bant and Grixis into the new Alara.
timeline.quote: Esper's borders continued to smash into Bant and Grixis until it became part of the new Alara.

citation.text: "Esper", section "The Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Grixis becomes part of the New Alara, demon cults rise, and after Malfegor dies chaos reigns among factions.
timeline.quote: After the death of the plane's de facto leader, Malfegor , chaos reigns

citation.text: "Grixis", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Naya becomes part of New Alara as the shards connect.
timeline.quote: Naya's borders continued to run into the borders of Jund and Bant until it had completely connected to the other five shards, becoming part of New Alara.

citation.text: "Naya", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The convergence of the shards lets creatures travel into neighboring shards.
timeline.quote: We got to show how the convergence of the shards has allowed creatures from each shard had traveled into shards that border their own.

citation.text: "Incursion Zones". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Grixis terrain bursts through Jund lava while Jund crags pierce Grixis necropolises.
timeline.quote: The dead terrain of Grixis would burst up through Jund's red-hot pools of lava, while the volcanic crags would pierce through Grixis's necropolises.

citation.text: "Incursion Zones". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The shards of Alara come together in the Conflux, open war breaks out between adjacent shards, and Nicol Bolas rises.
timeline.quote: Conflux is, of course, about the shards coming together, but also about open war breaking out between the "adjacent" shards

citation.text: "The Vorthos Awards: Conflux Edition". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The art of the card Conflux shows Nicol Bolas's claw closing in on the reunited Alara.
timeline.quote: The card's art shows Nicol Bolas's claw closing in on the five-color power of a reunited Alara

citation.work: Vorthos Award Results and Keyword Flavor
citation.text: "Vorthos Award Results and Keyword Flavor". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: A lonely floating throne marks the absence of the archangel Asha, as shown by Sigil of the Empty Throne.
timeline.quote: the story of Asha and the lonely, floating throne that marks the archangel's absence

citation.work: Vorthos Award Results and Keyword Flavor
citation.text: "Vorthos Award Results and Keyword Flavor". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The column explains that the Conflux has so far physically overlapped only adjacent shards, so Esper's main conflicts are with Bant and Grixis.
timeline.quote: the main conflicts for Esper have been with Bant and Grixis

citation.text: "Tipping the Scales". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Esper and Grixis crush together at their frontiers, with thousands dying.
timeline.quote: Thousands die at every frontier!

citation.text: "Tipping the Scales". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas is said to have fled Dominaria and spent years building conflict between the shards.
timeline.quote: He's spent many years (since when he fled Dominaria at the end of the Future Sight novel)

citation.text: "Tipping the Scales". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Bolas is pursuing early stages of his plan and may be discovered by forces of Alara and other planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: But since he has to move more quickly now, his plans may be discovered.

citation.work: The One, The Only, Nicol Bolas
citation.text: "The One, The Only, Nicol Bolas". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol acquires the power to summon Karrthus personally and they wreak havoc together.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan Vol acquires the power to summon this tyrannical brute personally.

citation.text: "Jund's Trump Card". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Across Alara, people face hard dilemmas and make choices that decide their fates in the rejoined plane and the inter-shard war.
timeline.quote: All over Alara, people are now facing just these kinds of dilemmas, and making the choices that determine their fates.

citation.text: "Choices in the New Alara". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Creatures are taken by summoning, mind control and force from one shard and recruited into the war on another.
timeline.quote: Through summoning, mind control, and sheer force, many creatures have been taken from one shard and recruited into the war on another.

citation.text: "Choices in the New Alara". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Kings and queens of old Alara begin returning as spectral protectors for the soldiers in the plane's war.
timeline.quote: Kings and queens of old Alara have begun to return in spectral form, bearing magical protection for the soldiers in the plane's vast war.

citation.text: "Choices in the New Alara". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ajani, traumatized by his brother's death, ignites his planeswalker spark and becomes open to red magic.
timeline.quote: Ajani, thanks to the trauma behind his brother's death, not only ignites his planeswalker spark but also becomes open to furious red magic

citation.text: "Choices in the New Alara". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Knight of New Alara declares that he embraces all of Alara and acts because it is right, not for accolades, even if his former home calls him traitor.
timeline.quote: I embrace all of Alara, Grixis as much as Bant.

citation.text: Knight of New Alara (Alara Reborn Promos, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Maelstrom sends a wave of raw mana across a battlefield, carrying off the fighting and the fallen alike.
timeline.quote: The Maelstrom sent a wave of raw mana through the battlefield, carrying off the fighting and fallen alike.

citation.text: Soulquake (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Alarans commemorate a hellion's appearances with holidays like the Great Cataclysm and the Fall of Ilson Gate.
timeline.quote: Alarans commemorated its appearances with new holidays bearing names like the Great Cataclysm and the Fall of Ilson Gate.

citation.text: Blitz Hellion (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A knight embraces all of Alara, Grixis as much as Bant, though his former home calls him traitor.
timeline.quote: Let my former home call me traitor.

citation.text: Knight of New Alara (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: During the collision of the shards entire ways of life vanish without a trace.
timeline.quote: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.

citation.text: Maelstrom Pulse (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas's plans reach their zenith as the five shards of Alara merge.
timeline.quote: The violent plans orchestrated by Nicol Bolas have reached their cataclysmic zenith, as the five shards of Alara are now merged

citation.text: "Alara Reborn", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Since the shards reconverged, the Maelstrom has grown from a tiny seed to a raging tempest feeding on the Alaran war.
timeline.quote: Since the shards reconverged, the Maelstrom has grown from a tiny seed to a raging tempest of potential

citation.text: "The Day a Vedalken Exploded". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 6 May 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas leaves the Maelstrom unguarded because it destroys or scares off interlopers on its own.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas has set up no guardians of the Maelstrom.

citation.text: "The Day a Vedalken Exploded". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 6 May 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Alarans are only now discovering the Maelstrom; no planeswalker but Bolas knows of it.
timeline.quote: not even a planeswalker (other than Bolas) knows of its existence yet

citation.text: "The Day a Vedalken Exploded". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 6 May 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Naya elves journey through the rotting land of Grixis, and Grixis undead assault a Bant stronghold, as examples of Alara Reborn's fusion of shards.
timeline.quote: Zealous Persecution shows Grixis undead assaulting a Bant stronghold.

citation.text: "Reality Check". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Some Grixis humans stayed behind rather than emigrate after the Conflux.
timeline.quote: I actually do think there are some living Grixis humans who didn't emigrate after the Conflux.

citation.work: Once More Unto the Mailbox, Dear Friends
citation.text: "Once More Unto the Mailbox, Dear Friends". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 May 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The narrator, a creative designer working late, finds the Homelost Elf card too simple and lacking character.
timeline.quote: Things needed to get Vorthos all up in here, and they needed to do so now.

citation.work: A Different Kind of Origin Story
citation.text: "A Different Kind of Origin Story". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jun 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The narrator wakes in his bedroom, finds the card art changed to a capable warrior, and renames it.
timeline.quote: I changed its name, and signed off.

citation.work: A Different Kind of Origin Story
citation.text: "A Different Kind of Origin Story". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jun 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Alara becomes one plane in the aftermath of the Conflux.
timeline.quote: now that it's one plane in the aftermath of the Conflux

citation.text: "The Planes of Planechase". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Maelstrom develops from a storm of mana at the center where all five shards of Alara overlapped.
timeline.quote: it's the storm of mana that developed at the chaotic center point where all five shards of Alara overlapped

citation.text: "The Planes of Planechase". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Bolas fed on the power of Alara's mana, holding off the crumbling of his mind and body after the Mending.
timeline.quote: By feeding on the power of Alara's mana, Bolas forestalled the post-Mending crumbling of his mind and body for a time

citation.text: "What Is Flavor?". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 25 May 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ajani's quest to discover his brother's killer leads him to a face-to-face conflict with Bolas.
timeline.quote: Ajani's quest to discover his brother's killer led to a face-to-face conflict with Mr. Bolas himself

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas, Archenemy". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan succumbs to Bolas's rule.
timeline.quote: the dragon-worshipper having succumbed to Bolas's rule.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas, Archenemy". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Grixis falls under Bolas's sway while Esper ignores his influence until too late.
timeline.quote: Grixis was firmly under the sway of Nicol Bolas

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas, Archenemy". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Alara breaks into five shards, so Grixis feels a strong hunger for white and green mana.
timeline.quote: When Alara broke into its five shards, the hunger for those life-oriented colors of mana, white and green, was strongly felt.

citation.work: The Art of New Phyrexia's Factions
citation.text: "The Art of New Phyrexia's Factions". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Breya discovers carmot in Jund and replaces most of her body with etherium she created herself.
timeline.quote: To prove her achievement, Breya replaced the majority of her organic body with etherium she created herself.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Silas Renn rises in the Seekers of Carmot and receives the first etherium heart.
timeline.quote: he was honored with the first etherium heart ever produced

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Bolas takes Tezzeret into his service.
timeline.quote: Bolas offered him power in exchange for servitude, which Tezzeret accepted.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Seeker's Fall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: About 60 years later, Domri Rade performs the Burying in Utvara; the stress ignites his spark and sends him to Alara.
timeline.quote: The stress of the experience caused his planeswalker spark to ignite, sending him to Alara from inside the sarcophagus he was buried in.

citation.text: "Utvara Valley", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ral and the Wanderer find Tezzeret on Alara; Tezzeret beats Ral and gives him his damaged arm as proof of a kill.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret showed mercy and gave Ral his damaged etherium arm to provide proof of a kill

citation.text: "Ral Zarek", section "Confrontation with Tezzeret". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn's Machine Legion strikes Alara.
timeline.quote: Alara as was targeted by Elesh Norn 's Machine Legion as part of the New Phyrexian Invasion with a simultaneous strike on Bant, Esper, and Jund.

citation.text: "Esper", section "New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn's Machine Legion strikes Alara in the New Phyrexian Invasion; the Maelstrom awakens to defend it.
timeline.quote: the Maelstrom itself awoke to fight on behalf of Alara

citation.text: "Grixis", section "New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn's Machine Legion targets Alara in the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Alara was targeted by Elesh Norn 's Machine Legion as part of the New Phyrexian Invasion

citation.text: "Alara", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the invasion the Maelstrom awakens to fight on behalf of Alara.
timeline.quote: the Maelstrom itself awoke to fight on behalf of Alara

citation.text: "Bant", section "New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Alara is struck at Bant, Esper and Jund as part of the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: as part of the New Phyrexian Invasion with a simultaneous strike on Bant, Esper, and Jund.

citation.text: "Jund", section "New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Maelstrom awakens to fight on behalf of Alara.
timeline.quote: the Maelstrom itself awoke to fight on behalf of Alara.

citation.text: "Jund", section "New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn's Machine Legion strikes Alara in the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Alara as was targeted by Elesh Norn 's Machine Legion as part of the New Phyrexian Invasion with a simultaneous strike on Bant, Esper, and Jund.

citation.text: "Naya", section "New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ajani's brother Jazal is killed during the Conflux Wars while trying to broker peace.
timeline.quote: Ajani's brother, Jazal, was a kind and just leader struck down during Alara's Conflux Wars while trying to broker peace.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.
